title: docs(skills): objectstack-platform declares engines.protocol '^18', the major the 18.x boot handshake accepts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5YusjSEHT8KRnVbiKjJ22B)_

Fixes #25671

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

The published `objectstack-platform` skill taught `engines: { protocol: '^17' }` in its `defineStack` manifest example. On `main`, `PROTOCOL_VERSION` is `18.0.0` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts`), and the boot handshake in `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` refuses a range that excludes the runtime major (`OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE`, 422), so a config copied from the skill failed to boot on 18.x. The scaffold (`create-objectstack`) and every example app already write `'^18'`.

Landing point — the three sites the card names, plus one sibling line in the same eval file:

- `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L142: `'^17'` → `'^18'`.
- `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` L7 (expected output): `'^17'` → `'^18'`; and L6 (the eval prompt) `targets protocol 17` → `targets protocol 18`, so the eval stays internally consistent — a prompt asking for 17 with an expected output of `'^18'` would grade a correct answer wrong. Same file, same byte length, no extra line.
- `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` L89: the sentence stating what every scaffold and example writes now says `'^18'`, which is what they write. The `'^17'` → `--from 17` worked example on L91 is unchanged on purpose: it demonstrates taking the floor of a range, and `--from 17` is a real upgrade path.
- `.changeset/25671-skills-protocol-caret.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

Acceptance check from the card: `git grep -n "protocol: '\^17'" skills/` at head `401e0bc0` returns only `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md:91`, the worked upgrade example.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么:** 对外发布的 `objectstack-platform` 技能里,`defineStack` 示例的 `engines.protocol` 从 `'^17'` 改为 `'^18'`;同一技能的 eval 用例(提示词与期望输出一起)同步到 18;`objectstack-upgrade` 里「脚手架和示例都写 `'^17'`」这句改为 `'^18'`,与脚手架实际写入一致。`'^17'` → `--from 17` 的升级演算示例保留不动。附一个 `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset。

**为什么改:** 当前运行时协议版本是 18.0.0,启动握手会拒绝排除了 18 的范围(`OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE`)。客户项目从技能文本照抄配置,一启动就失败;脚手架与所有示例早已写 `'^18'`,只有技能文本落后了一个大版本。

**风险与代价(含回滚):** 纯文档与 eval 文本,运行时零改动;四行等长替换,技能包的行数与 token 计数前后完全不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR;唯一代价是客户项目再次拿到会启动失败的示例。

**席位意见:**

**你要做的:** `skills/**` 为 Tier H,本 PR 保持 draft 等待授权审批;审批后由席位落地。

## Acceptance notes

- No gate catches this class today: `check:skill-compatibility` reads only the frontmatter, and nothing cross-checks a `protocol:` literal in skill prose against `PROTOCOL_VERSION`. Noted, not filed: a read-only observation with no reproduced wrong answer beyond this card's; carrier: none.
- The eval prompt edit (L6) is the one line outside the three the card names. Omitting it would have left the eval asking for protocol 17 and expecting `'^18'`.
- `check:doc-formula-expressions` first answered exit 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt in a fresh worktree). After `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` under the verify lock it answered exit 0 (`23 record-scoped formula example(s) across 478 files judged clean`). The 3 was never a finding.

## Gates (local subset at head `401e0bc0`; exit codes captured before any pipe)

`dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 47 families for this diff. 43 ran locally, every one exit 0, among them: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (and `--self-test`), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs` (`Skill docs in sync`), `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync`, `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `pnpm check:skill-compatibility`, `pnpm check:skill-top-level-keys`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `pnpm check:role-word`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:corpus-claim-drift`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:merge-driver`, `pnpm check:published-files`, `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `pnpm check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`.

Declared to CI, not run locally (4 of 47, matched only through the `Build Core` job path filter in `ci.yml`, none of them reads a `skills/**` file, each needs a full core build): `pnpm check:dts-closure`, `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure`, `pnpm check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. `--ran` reconciliation: `47 derived, 43 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 4 UNRUN` naming exactly those four. `test:repo` and the full lint farm are CI's.

No package build or test closure is owed: the diff touches no workspace package source.
